title: Airport Transfers
quote: Whether it's airport transfers, corporate travel, family trips or special occasions, we provide professional drivers and quality service to make every journey seamless.
summary: A chauffeur-driven ride to or from the airport, with room for the whole group and the luggage, quoted on request.
body: Tell us your airport, flight and the time you land or need to leave. We use those details to arrange your vehicle and confirm your quote before you travel.

A 7-seater makes sense when you are travelling as a family or a team, or simply with a lot of bags. If your plans change or your flight moves, call or message us and we will work out the next step with you.
Arrangements at the terminal are confirmed with your booking, so you will know how the pickup works before you fly.

faqs.q: What details do you need for an airport transfer?
faqs.a: Your airport, the date and time, how many passengers and bags, and the area you are travelling to or from. A flight number helps for pickups.

faqs.q: What happens if my flight is delayed?
faqs.a: Call or message us as soon as you can, and we will work out the next step with you.

faqs.q: How much does a transfer cost?
faqs.a: Airport transfers are quoted on request. Send your details and we will confirm your quote.

title: Chauffeur-Driven Hire
quote: Enjoy comfortable, reliable and hassle-free chauffeur-driven rides with Kev Auto Hire.
summary: A vehicle and a professional driver for a single journey, a full day or several days, so you can sit back and enjoy the ride.
body: A professional driver takes the route, the traffic and the parking off your mind. Use the time to talk, rest, make your calls or simply look out of the window.

Tell us where you need to be and when. It may be one journey, a day of appointments, or several days on the road. Pick a vehicle from the fleet, or tell us the occasion and how many of you are travelling, and we will suggest one.
We will confirm availability, the arrangements and your quote when you book. We serve Nairobi and beyond, so your plans need not stop at the city limits.

faqs.q: Can I book a driver for several days?
faqs.a: Yes, tell us your dates and plans in your request and we will confirm availability and your quote.

faqs.q: Can you take me out of Nairobi?
faqs.a: Yes, we serve clients countrywide. Tell us where you are going, and the route and arrangements are confirmed when you book.

title: Weddings
quote: Our chauffeur driven 7-seater vans are perfect for weddings, airport transfers, business trips, and family travel.
summary: Chauffeur-driven 7-seaters to move the bridal party, the family and your guests on the day.
body: A wedding day runs on timing. Seven seats per vehicle means fewer cars to coordinate, and a professional driver means nobody in the bridal party has to think about the road.
Share your date, your venue and how many vehicles you have in mind. We will confirm availability, the plan for the day and your quote.
Tell us your timings once you have them, and we will handle the journey. Your only job is to arrive.

faqs.q: Can you do a wedding outside Nairobi?
faqs.a: Yes, we serve clients countrywide. Share your venue and we will confirm the arrangements.

faqs.q: How many vehicles can I request?
faqs.a: You can request up to 10 on this form. For anything larger, call or message us on WhatsApp.

title: Corporate Travel
summary: Chauffeur-driven vehicles for business trips, visiting guests and teams who need to travel together.
body: When a team travels together, the day runs more smoothly. A 7-seater with a professional driver keeps everyone on the same schedule, from the hotel to the meeting and on to the airport.
Send us the dates, the stops and how many people are travelling. A single business trip and several vehicles for a visiting delegation start with the same short request.
We will confirm availability and your quote, and we are a phone call or a WhatsApp message away if plans change.

faqs.q: Can you provide several vehicles for one trip?
faqs.a: Tell us how many you need and when. We will confirm what is available and send your quote.
We only use your details to arrange your booking. See our privacy notice for more.

title: Family Trips & Road Trips
quote: Wherever you're headed, travel in comfort and style.
summary: Room for the whole family and the bags, with a professional driver, for a weekend away or a longer road trip.
body: Road trips are better when everyone can sit back. Seven seats leave room for the family, the bags and the snacks, and a professional driver means nobody spends the trip watching the road.
Tell us where you are headed, your dates and how many of you are travelling. We serve clients countrywide, and the route and arrangements are confirmed when you book.
Book today and let us handle the journey.

faqs.a: Yes, we serve clients countrywide. Tell us your route and we will confirm what suits it.
Our vehicles are 7-seaters. Tell us how many of you are travelling, and how much luggage, and we will suggest the right number of vehicles.
